items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: I played more regular with Joe Oliver than I did Louis.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, clarinetist, that's right. Played with Oliver. Mm-hmm. Did you ever play with Louis Armstrong? Louis Armstrong, I played with him a while a little bit. He played with us over at the Dream. We had him playing with us there. He played with us a while over there. But I never played regular with Louis. I played more regular with Joe Oliver than I did Louis.
